title: A 3D multi-modal atlas of non-small cell lung cancer reveals niche-specific cellular ecosystems
abstract: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is the leading cause of cancer death worldwide, yet the cellular ecosystems that shape its niches in three dimensions remain incompletely characterized. Here we present a 3D multi-modal atlas of NSCLC combining CosMx spatial transcriptomics, second-harmonic generation imaging of the extracellular matrix, and per-donor whole-exome sequencing across multiple patients. We identify reproducible niche-specific cell-cell communication patterns and quantify how ECM architecture co-varies with immune infiltration. The atlas resolves a tension in the literature between bulk-level and single-cell-level interpretations of tumor heterogeneity by anchoring both modalities in 3D tissue coordinates.
